notes.title: Final Early Access Update - (1.0)
notes.content:
Woo! This update marks the transition of my game out of early access. With this patch I have fixed just about every bug that was on my list and polished up some other things. To list a few:

- Fixed a bug where the global leader board scores wouldn't load when the game first launches

- Changed the Pro Shop transport bubble to require a trigger pull rather than just touching it to avoid accidentally ending a round

- Fixed a bug which caused the club to resize to a longer length when a new hole loads if it was previously the longest possible length

- Altered the terrain on 16 to make it a little easier

- Altered spawn locations for players to make it more convenient (i.e. moved right for left handed shots and vice-versa)

I'm sure there are a couple more I'm forgetting, I've done a fair amount since last update but those are the main points. As for the future, I'm not 100% sure on my plans for the game going forward, I could add a little if I feel like it but I have nothing planned at the moment.

I want to say thank you to everyone who has been playing and following along my dev process, I appreciate it immensely that you are willing to support people like me as we try to complete a project, you are the best!

notes.title: Full 18 with Global Boards - (0.5.0)
notes.content:
This update is rather exciting for me as I have finally completed the original vision I had for this game at its inception. I am still a ways away from being "finished", but I finally have a full 18 hole course with functioning Local and Global leader boards. I even made a driving range, which I hadn't originally planned, but turned out to be a fun addition.

I think I still have one or two updates to do before publishing a version 1.0 and leaving Early Access. There is still a minor bug or two and I can do a bit more polishing. I also want to add one or two things that aren't necessary but would be nice to have.

Main features of this update are:
- Global and Local leader board for front and back nine
- Some terrain fixes on 16 and 18
- Fixed a keyboard bug on 18
- Changed par for back nine (2 strokes easier now) 

Anyway, I hope everyone has had fun playing my game as it's been developing and I want to sincerely thank everyone, especially those who have left comments or thumbs ups, I really appreciate it. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Driving Range Fix and Added Option - (0.3.3)
notes.content:
Fixed some performance bugs in the driving range scene and also added the option to turn the trail behind the driver head on or off. I know I found it helpful when I was getting used to the distance but once I knew where to swing consistently I wanted it off so now the option is in there.

 I'm still working on the last few holes but it's been taking me longer than I originally thought because I recently had to get a full time job so now I have way less time. Thanks to everyone for your patience and for playing.

notes.title: Global Leaderboard and More - (0.2.9)
notes.content:
For this update I have finally thrown together a global leaderboard so you can  see how your putting compares to others around the world. It currently will display just the top 10 but I'll change that to 50 or something if more people start playing.

Other Additions/Fixes:

- Added some detail to leaderboards
- Fixed a bug allowing the club to collide with the menu
- Fine tuned haptic feedback on ball strikes so it is more responsive to the speed of your swing giving added realism
- Added a boat as a target on the driving range which will do something (have to play to see) when you hit it
- Changed the music and waves volume toggles in the pro-shop to sliders for increased customization
- Fixed some inconsistencies in haptic feedback for menus and clubs on multiple holes
- Fixed a bug on the driving range which caused balls to stop appearing if you switched which hand was holding the club

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Driving Range and Bug Fixes - (0.2.8)
notes.content:
I'm still working on new holes but in the meantime I decided it would be fun to include a driving range If you feel the desire to knock endless golf balls into the ocean. I'll admit I tested for longer than I needed to because I was enjoying it so much. It has the standard ball tracker and distance counter and the scoreboard remembers your best drive.
 Additionally, I noticed that almost all of the features I added last update were not working properly (if at all), so this update should fix all of the bugs from the previous update. Thanks for the patience ːsteamhappyː

See driving range here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=793572565

Specific Bugs Fixed:

- Problem initializing connection to Steamworks API, Steam name should now appear above keyboard after completing the final hole

- Problem with "selection orbs" on the new menu options (Now displaying and hiding properly)

- Player now spawns on appropriate side of the ball via hand preference selection at the beginning of the round

-Instead of pulling the trigger to reverse club direction, the proper club will just spawn (should work perfectly now)

notes.title: Added some menu options and terrain detail - (0.2.7)
notes.content:
For this update I've added a few things which were recommended by a helpful user.

- Now a "reset one stroke" and "reset hole" option on the application menu

- Can now select whether you shoot left or right at the beginning of a round (still buggy, club randomly switches back on new holes sometimes), which will also re-position the players initial spawn point

- Added terrain details for hopefully a more realistic look (feedback welcome)

- The leaderboard entry should default to your steam name now if you fill nothing out, you still must press enter on the keyboard though. (Still a WIP might not work)  

-also added some fog for extra depth on map

notes.title: Major Update is here!
notes.content:
It's finally here! The first major update I've been slaving over. It's essentially an overhaul of the entire game. I could just list everything in the game but here are some of the more prominent updates:

- new models and textures for pretty much everything
- 9 updated and refined holes
- replaced controller models with animated hands
- completely refined the putter, now length and direction are alterable
- new, more realistic and detailed terrains
- now able to teleport on terrains
- new, far more reliable method of registering a sunk putt
- more sound effects
- more controller feedback
- more objects to interact with
- tweaked ball physics
- more complete and creative menu/settings system

Basically everything is more polished, more fleshed out, more fun and runs better. You can check out the new trailer on the store page for a peek. I hope you all enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

(PSA: I altered the installation config so if you already have the game you may have to re-install)
